setups.name: Opening Range Breakout
setups.description: First 15-minute range breaks with relative volume above 2x.
setups.thesis: Momentum names that gap into a level and hold the open drive continue in the direction of the break.
checklist: Relative volume > 2x at the open
Clean 15-minute range, no overlapping wicks
Break holds for a full 1-minute close
Stop under the range low / above the range high

setups.name: Pullback to VWAP
setups.description: Trend day retracement into rising VWAP with a lower-volume pullback.
setups.thesis: In a trend day the first controlled pullback into VWAP offers the best reward-to-risk continuation entry.
checklist: Higher highs and higher lows on the 5-minute
Pullback volume lower than the impulse leg
VWAP still sloping in trade direction
Risk defined at the pullback swing

setups.name: Failed Breakdown
setups.description: Price loses an obvious support level and reclaims it within two bars.
setups.thesis: Trapped sellers below a well-watched level fuel the squeeze back through it.
checklist: Obvious level everyone can see
Reclaim happens inside two 5-minute bars
Volume expands on the reclaim
Stop below the flush low

setups.name: Earnings Momentum
setups.description: Post-earnings drift in the direction of the gap, entered on day two or three.
setups.thesis: Large earnings gaps on raised guidance keep drifting as funds build positions over several sessions.
checklist: Gap larger than 5% on raised guidance
Day-one close in the top third of the range
No entry before the day-one high is taken
Size halved versus a normal swing

setups.name: Mean Reversion
setups.description: Extended move into a band edge with momentum divergence.
setups.thesis: Over-extended moves without news snap back toward the mean once the last buyer or seller is done.
checklist: At least three consecutive extended bars
No fundamental catalyst behind the move
Divergence on the 5-minute
Half size, wider stop

setups.name: Trend Continuation
setups.description: Multi-day swing in a name making higher highs above a rising 20-day.
setups.thesis: Institutional accumulation shows up as an orderly staircase above the 20-day moving average.
checklist: Above a rising 20-day moving average
Base of at least four sessions
Entry on the base high breaking
Stop under the base low

setups.name: Gap Fill
setups.description: Unfilled overnight gap against the prevailing trend.
setups.thesis: Gaps without news tend to fill during the first hour as overnight liquidity unwinds.
checklist: Gap under 2% with no headline
Opposite the prevailing daily trend
Enter only after the first 5-minute reversal bar
Target the prior close

setups.name: Breakout Retest
setups.description: Prior resistance retested as support after a clean breakout.
setups.thesis: The first retest of a broken level is where the risk is tightest and the level is still respected.
checklist: Breakout closed above the level on volume
Retest arrives within three sessions
Level holds on a closing basis
Stop below the retest low
